newsitem.title: INDIA: Honda to raise stake in India unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Honda to raise stake in India unit - paper.

text.p: Japan's Honda Motor Co plans to spend more than 620 million rupees ($17.3 million) buying a majority stake in an Indian subsidiary, Shriram Honda Power Equipment Ltd, the Economic Times said on Monday.
The daily said the Japanese firm was in talks with its Indian partner, Shriram Industrial Enterprises Ltd (SIEL), to raise its stake in the joint venture to 56 percent from 33 percent.
SIEL also holds 33 percent of the venture's equity, with the rest held by public and financial institutions.
The newspaper quoted SIEL chairman Siddharth Shriram as saying his company would sell 23 percent of the joint venture's equity to Honda, leaving SIEL with a 10 percent stake.
Shriram Honda controls about 60 percent of the Indian power generator set market, estimated at some 90,000 generators in 1997. ($1=35.8 rupees)
